entities.summary: Jared Corey Kushner is an American businessman, investor, and government official. He is the son-in-law of the 45th and 47th president of the United States, Donald Trump, through his marriage to Ivanka Trump and served as a senior advisor in his father-in-law's first administration from 2017 to 2021. He was also director of the Office of American Innovation.
